messages:
Aisha CSM: FYI - Nimbus Analytics renewal landed. They want net-60 to align with their fiscal close and want to drop 10 seats for Q3 due to internal headcount freeze. Procurement insists on a PO with vendor code; their PO lists vendor 'NIM-EU-2026' but our billing is under NIM US. Can we do short-term billing accommodation?
Naveen RevOps: Net-60 + seat reduction is doable but impacts ARR recognition. Suggest keeping list price and offer a one-time billing accommodation: defer invoicing 30 days and apply pro-rated credit for removed seats for the remaining term. That keeps renewal ARR transparent.
Marta Finance: Defer invoicing needs a signed amendment and finance approval. Vendor code mismatch will block AP if left unresolved. We need customer to confirm legal entity or provide intercompany mapping. Also request PO number for invoicing reference.
Sofia Legal: We can prepare a 1-paragraph amendment: record net-60 payment term for this renewal only, and document seat reduction with a pro-rated credit amount. Must reference PO number explicitly. No entity swap without exec sign-off.
Aisha CSM: Customer asked explicitly that the credit and net-60 not delay onboarding for new replaced seats. They want an enablement session for remaining users ASAP.
Eli Enablement: We can run the kickoff as scheduled for the remaining seat count. Offer a 2-hour enablement session now and a follow-up 1-hour session after billing clears. Will gather onboarding feedback in short pulse survey.
Naveen RevOps: Quick math: pro-rated credit for 10 seats (~$7,500) applied one-time. If Finance okay, we log credit and keep renewal ARR shown at full term to avoid downstream quota distortion.
Marta Finance: $7.5k credit OK if amendment is signed and PO referenced. Also ask for backup CC on file in case the PO processing misses the net-60 SLA. Please push customer to confirm vendorcode by EOD.
Sofia Legal: Draft amendment snippet: 
```
Amendment: For renewal dated 2026-07-01, Customer is granted a one-time pro-rated credit of $7,500 for the removal of 10 seats. Payment term is net-60 for this renewal only. Invoice must reference Customer PO #<<PO_NUM>>. This amendment does not change the governing MSA or billing entity.
```
Aisha CSM: I'll chase PO and vendorcode with the procurement contact. @docusign-bot please queue amendment envelope once Sofia posts it. Also logging this as feedback: procurement tooling + unclear vendorcode naming causing friction. :eyes: :memo:
docusign-bot: Envelope NIM-2026-AM1 queued to <procurement@nimbus.com>. Status: envelope created.
Eli Enablement: I'll schedule the 2-hr kickoff for next Mon and send a calendar invite contingent on seat list. Will capture the survey results and send to CS team.
Naveen RevOps: I'll update the renewal record: credit $7,500, net-60 note, seat change -10. Target: PO + signed amendment by 2026-06-08. If missing, mark renewal at-risk and loop AE.
Marta Finance: Noted. If PO arrives after invoice creation window, we may need to issue a credit note. We'll prepare for that possibility. Also confirm whether credit should be applied to the first invoice or as a separate credit memo.
Sofia Legal: I'll post the amendment to docusign within the hour. Aisha, if they report access issues, please capture the error and escalate.
Aisha CSM: Understood. Risk = medium until PO + signed amendment. Action owners: Aisha (PO & vendorcode chase + DocuSign follow-up), Sofia (amendment draft & send), Naveen (renewal update & ARR calc), Marta (billing path & credit memo plan), Eli (enablement & survey). Will update the renewal thread after PO confirmation. Thanks :thumbsup:
